title: Discovery of An au-scale Excess in Millimeter Emission from the Protoplanetary Disk around TW Hya
question: Is there small-scale (au-scale) non-axisymmetric substructure in the 1.3 mm dust continuum of the TW Hya disk, and what is its origin?

data.bands: Band 6 (233 GHz, 1.3 mm) new; Band 7 archival (center 325.4 GHz)
data.sensitivity: Band 6 rms 9.1 uJy/beam; Band 7 rms 27.7 uJy/beam

what.value: Dust mass opacity 2.8 cm2/g at 870 um, beta ~0.5

evidence.quote: determined from $\kappa_\nu$ of 2.8 cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ at a wavelength of 870 $\mu$m (cite: bib:andrews2012)

what.value: Proper motion of TW Hya system

evidence.quote: according to the proper motion of the TW Hya system (cite: bib:gaia2016)

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, concatenation, multiscale CLEAN with self-calibration

recipe.goal: Measure excess relative to surrounding disk
recipe.method: Compare peak intensity with mean of surrounding emission in azimuthal ranges; radial and azimuthal profiles

recipe.goal: Subtract axisymmetric disk and fit excess in uv domain
recipe.method: Subtract axisymmetric emission in visibility domain, then least-squares single Gaussian fit with uvmodelfit
Planck function brightness temperature; M = F d^2/(kappa B(T))
assumptions: kappa = 2.3 cm2/g at 233 GHz (beta ~0.5), T_dust = 18 K, d = 59.5 pc, uniform background

recipe.goal: Check against background-source hypothesis with Band 7
recipe.method: Compare position of residual in Band 7 image (2 yr earlier) with Band 6 position versus expected proper motion

evidence.quote: The peak intensity at this feature is measured to be 308.4 $\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$, corresponding to signal-to-noise (SN) ratio of 34.
hence the excess is calculated to be 111.5$\pm$9.1 $\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$ ($\sim12\sigma$)
The total intensity of the fitted Gaussian is 250$\pm$5 $\mu$Jy.
the brightness temperature at the position of the emission feature is converted using the Planck function to be 11.6 K
the total dust mass of the emission feature is (2.83$\pm$0.06)$\times10^{-2}$ $M_\oplus$

not_stated_but_needed: Which of the listed Band 7 projects/execution blocks were used, and how they map to the eight datasets
Self-calibration solution intervals, number of rounds and reference
CLEAN threshold, masks, cell/image size, iterations
Method and parameters of axisymmetric model subtraction in uv domain (radial profile used, center, inclination/PA)
Flux calibrator flux values and which calibrator for which EB
score_reason: Data are public and main steps are named with key imaging parameters, but self-cal and axisymmetric subtraction details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results, and reasonably clear recipe, though the axisymmetric subtraction is underspecified.
